mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant electrolyte depletion (particularly hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia) which increases QT prolongation risk, and ondansetron also prolongs QT interval, creating additive cardiac effects.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes (K+, Mg2+) regularly; consider alternative antiemetics if possible; maintain electrolyte supplementation during amphotericin B therapy.
